component.name: KeyScribe
component.summary: Polyphonic music transcription and stem separation

description.p: KeyScribe is a desktop application that transcribes polyphonic music from audio files. It detects notes, separates audio stems, generates sheet music, and transcribes videos — all running locally on your machine using ONNX Runtime with optional GPU acceleration.

ul.li: Polyphonic note detection from audio files (WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, M4A)
6-stem source separation (vocals, drums, bass, piano, guitar, other) using Demucs
MusicXML sheet music export with in-app engraved preview
GPU acceleration via CUDA (NVIDIA) for faster inference
All processing runs locally — no cloud API required
